meta.title: Career — Priya Vishwanathan
meta.description: Thirty-five years with IHCL: St. James’ Court in London, the Taj Mahal in New Delhi, Business Excellence, Karnataka and amã Stays & Trails.

sections.label: Career
sections.sub: From a duty manager’s desk in London to helping build a national homestay brand.

sections.label: amã Stays & Trails
sections.title: A brand, built <t>and scaled.</t>
sections.lede: “The journey culminated in one of the most fulfilling chapters of helping build and scale amã Stays & Trails into a distinctive hospitality brand.” Priya Vishwanathan, 2026. Figures: IHCL.

groups.label: Milestones
names: 2019 — Launched by IHCL with nine Tata Coffee bungalows in Coorg and Chikmagalur
2024 — 200+ bungalows, with 100+ under development
2025 — 250 bungalows, ten times the launch portfolio
2026 — 370+ bungalows across India

groups.label: On the record
names: “People came to us: can you take my home?” Families trusted the organisation with houses they had inherited.
“Hotels is a very different business and homestay is a completely different business.”
“Good to great really happens when you do something that touches somebody’s heart.”

sections.label: Business Excellence
sections.title: From isolated hotels <t>to one organisation.</t>
sections.lede: “We turned around the company, which was working in isolated hotels, to one organisation where everybody today has structured SOPs.” HospeTalk, 2026.

groups.label: Fifteen years in quality and Business Excellence
names: Assistant Manager, Quality, Taj Mahal, New Delhi — 1999
Manager, Quality, Corporate HR — 2001
Corporate Manager, Business Process, South Region — Taj Hotels Resorts & Palaces
Senior Assessor, Tata Business Excellence Model — eight external assessments of Tata companies
Customer-satisfaction work across more than 100 hotels

sections.label: Framework
sections.title: The Tata Business <t>Excellence Model.</t>
sections.body: The framework every Tata company is assessed against, adapted from the Malcolm Baldrige criteria. Eight external assessments as Senior Assessor, and the lens behind every engagement since: leadership, customers and people first; results as their consequence.
sections.src: Model structure: Tata Business Excellence Group.

sections.label: Roles at IHCL
sections.title: Operations, <t>then leadership.</t>
sections.lede: Compiled from public profiles and recorded interviews.

groups.label: Operations
names: Hotel Operations Management Trainee, IHCL — 1990
Duty Manager, Taj Mahal Hotel
Assistant Duty Manager, St. James’ Court Hotel, London — 1995
Manager, Club Floors, Taj Mahal, New Delhi — 1997

groups.label: Leadership
names: Regional Manager, Karnataka — eight years, Bengaluru
General Manager, amã Stays & Trails — helping build and scale IHCL’s homestay brand, pan-India: P&L, owners and partners, guests and teams

groups.label: Appointments
names: Board Advisor & Principal Consultant — HOSPI Sigma™, a Lean Six Sigma capability framework for hospitality, Scotland
Regional Jury (South) — 10th BW Hotelier Indian Hospitality Awards, 2026
National Vice President, Diversity & Inclusion Council — WICCI
India Chapter Chair for Employability — All Ladies League

groups.label: Degree
names: Hotel Management — Institute of Hotel Management, Catering & Nutrition (IHM Pusa), New Delhi — 1987–1990
